label: app:*
asserts: this change deploys this group. Derived from the diff and recomputed on every push, which is what makes the set a manifest rather than a wish

label: itil:standard
asserts: the diff is limited to the deployable surface; this is a pre-authorised change type

label: itil:normal
asserts: the diff touches router/, gates/, change/, targets/ or .github/; this change needs assessment

label: itil:emergency
asserts: THIS change is the remedy and it outranks the others. A precedence claim, not a readiness claim. Never derived, never inferred

label: control-plane
asserts: this change alters how every FUTURE change is verified, so it cannot be verified by the pipeline it changes

label: labeler:skip
asserts: the declared writer of app:* and itil:standard/normal is now a person, not the labeller. TRANSFERS OWNERSHIP; silences no guard

label: change:requested
asserts: a person wants this change to begin. The only label a person adds to set a change going

label: release
asserts: a person wants a window. A trigger the scheduler consumes; one that stays on re-fires

label: change:scheduled
asserts: a window is booked. An entitlement to the path to production, not permission and not a promise

label: change:complete
asserts: TERMINAL and the record. Never cleared

label: change:failed
asserts: TERMINAL closure code: production never served this. Nothing to undo

label: change:backed-out
asserts: TERMINAL closure code: production DID serve this and was returned. Asserts an estate action, so it must name the sha it returned to

label: change:backfill-owed
asserts: AN UNPAID CHANGE RECORD. A person declares the debt and a person clears it; automation must not clear a debt it did not pay. Blocks nothing. Persistent, because the merge is when the debt starts

label: release:start
asserts: the release has BEGUN for the booked change. Never written by hand: adding it claims a deployment is running, which a person cannot truthfully assert

label: deploy:staging
asserts: staging is being deployed right now, AND the berth is claimed. An action label doing a lock's job

label: deploy:production
asserts: production is being deployed right now

label: staging:in-progress
asserts: an action is in flight against staging

label: staging:e2e
asserts: the e2e instrument passed against staging. Repeatable, so the LABEL authorizes nothing -- the record naming the SHA does

label: staging:e2e-failed
asserts: the e2e instrument failed. A recorded failure outranks its own pass in guard 4

label: staging:smoke
asserts: a browser could actually use staging

label: staging:smoke-failed
asserts: a browser could not

label: staging:uat
asserts: THE EXCEPTION: for acceptance the person IS the instrument. Not repeatable, so the label is durable and a person may withdraw it -- but it still needs a record naming this build

label: production:e2e
asserts: the e2e instrument passed against production

label: production:e2e-failed
asserts: it failed against production

label: production:smoke
asserts: a browser could use production

label: production:smoke-failed
asserts: it could not

label: production:healthy
asserts: the estate CONVERGED on this build. Typed by hand once, on #9; that was the ownership defect the whole declaration exists for

label: review:proxy
asserts: a proxy, NOT a person, reviewed this SHA. A different label from APPROVED on purpose, so nobody reads one as the other

label: blocked:queue
asserts: guard 1 refused: another open PR holds the berth

label: blocked:lock
asserts: guard 3's lock half refused: another deployment holds the lock

label: blocked:freeze
asserts: guard 3's freeze half refused: the estate is shut to ordinary change

label: blocked:diverged
asserts: guard 4b refused: main moved under this change. A human may clear it after rebasing

label: hold:staging
asserts: a person wants to look before this promotes. DECLARED REJECTED with no owner and human_add=no, and still enforced at three sites. The contradiction is the model, not a bug to resolve silently

label: freeze
asserts: ESTATE STATE: ordinary change is suspended. A property of the WORLD, blocking everyone including its declarer. Written by nobody in-tree, which is why the label auditor cannot see it -- it audits WRITES and this label is only ever read

label: emergency
asserts: ESTATE STATE: an emergency is in flight out there. Blocks standard and normal changes and grants NO exemption to whatever PR carries it. Deliberately no self-exclusion

label: staging:passed
asserts: named no measurement and no environment, so a pass from one estate could overwrite a failure from another. Replaced by the staging:* stack

label: staging:failed
asserts: same defect

label: deployed:production
asserts: replaced by change:complete plus the deployment record
